mainEntity.name: Do you work on the XKR-S GT engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The XKR-S GT uses the same 5.0 supercharged V8 family, and we assess it in the same careful way before recommending any work.

mainEntity.name: What is the XKR-S engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost depends on the engine, its availability and the labour required. We provide a quote after assessing your XKR-S instead of a fixed price.

mainEntity.name: Can you supply an XKR-S reconditioned engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, subject to availability. Where replacement is the better option, we can source and fit a reconditioned engine matched to your engine code.

mainEntity.name: Do you have an XKR-S engine for sale in the UK?

acceptedAnswer.text: Availability varies for performance engines like this. Contact us with your registration, and we will check what suitable options are currently available.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth rebuilding the XKR-S engine rather than replacing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Often, if the core components are sound. A rebuild keeps the original engine, but we only recommend it after inspection confirms it makes sense.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Jaguar XKR-S engine rebuild take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timescales depend on the fault, parts availability and machining required. We will give you an estimated timeframe once the engine has been assessed.

mainEntity.name: Can you collect my XKR-S from outside Essex?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We offer UK-wide collection and delivery, so XKR-S owners can access our workshop wherever they are based.
